# Balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA design
# Testing main effect of 3-level factor (Factor A)
# Effect size: partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Balanced design: n participants per cell, 6 cells total

# Step 1: Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter (lambda)
# For ANOVA F-test: lambda = (f^2 * df_error) / (1 - f^2)
# Or using partial eta-squared: partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_error)
# Therefore: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_error / (1 - partial_eta^2)

partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
df_numerator <- 2  # 3 levels - 1 for main effect of Factor A

# Function to compute power given n per cell
compute_power <- function(n_per_cell, partial_eta_sq, df_num, alpha) {
  # Total N = 6 cells * n per cell
  total_N <- 6 * n_per_cell
  # Denominator df in full factorial model: 6(n-1)
  df_denom <- 6 * (n_per_cell - 1)
  
  # Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter
  # partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_denom)
  # Solving for lambda: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_denom / (1 - partial_eta^2)
  lambda <- (partial_eta_sq * df_denom) / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  
  # Critical value from central F distribution
  f_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_num, df_denom)
  
  # Power is P(F > f_crit) under non-central F with non-centrality lambda
  power <- 1 - pf(f_crit, df_num, df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(
    n_per_cell = n_per_cell,
    total_N = total_N,
    df_numerator = df_num,
    df_denominator = df_denom,
    lambda = lambda,
    f_critical = f_crit,
    power = power
  ))
}

# Search for minimum n that achieves >= 0.80 power
power_results <- list()
for (n in 1:200) {
  result <- compute_power(n, partial_eta_sq, df_numerator, alpha)
  power_results[[n]] <- result
  
  if (n <= 50 || n %% 10 == 0 || (n >= 30 && n <= 60)) {
    cat(sprintf("n=%3d: power=%.6f, df_denom=%3d, lambda=%.4f\n",
                n, result$power, result$df_denominator, result$lambda))
  }
}

# Find minimum n achieving target power
min_n <- NA
for (n in 1:200) {
  if (power_results[[n]]$power >= target_power) {
    min_n <- n
    break
  }
}

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Minimum n per cell for 80%% power: %d\n", min_n))

# Display results for selected sample sizes around minimum
min_result <- power_results[[min_n]]
cat("\nAchieved design (minimum n):\n")
cat(sprintf("  n per cell: %d\n", min_result$n_per_cell))
cat(sprintf("  Total N: %d\n", min_result$total_N))
cat(sprintf("  df_numerator: %d\n", min_result$df_numerator))
cat(sprintf("  df_denominator: %d\n", min_result$df_denominator))
cat(sprintf("  Non-centrality parameter (lambda): %.6f\n", min_result$lambda))
cat(sprintf("  F-critical (alpha=0.05): %.6f\n", min_result$f_critical))

# Check preceding design

  cat("\nPreceding admissible design (n-1):\n")

  cat(sprintf("  F-critical (alpha=0.05): %.6f\n", prev_result$f_critical))
  cat(sprintf("  Power: %.6f\n", prev_result$power))
}

  min_n_per_cell = min_n,
  achieved_power = min_result$power,
  achieved_df_denom = min_result$df_denominator,

  partial_eta_squared = partial_eta_sq,

# Testing main effect of 3-level factor (Factor A)
# Effect size: partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Balanced design: n participants per cell, 6 cells total

# Step 1: Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter (lambda)
# For ANOVA F-test: lambda = (f^2 * df_error) / (1 - f^2)
# Or using partial eta-squared: partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_error)
# Therefore: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_error / (1 - partial_eta^2)

partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
df_numerator <- 2  # 3 levels - 1 for main effect of Factor A

# Function to compute power given n per cell
compute_power <- function(n_per_cell, partial_eta_sq, df_num, alpha) {
  # Total N = 6 cells * n per cell
  total_N <- 6 * n_per_cell
  # Denominator df in full factorial model: 6(n-1)
  df_denom <- 6 * (n_per_cell - 1)
  
  # Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter
  # partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_denom)
  # Solving for lambda: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_denom / (1 - partial_eta^2)
  lambda <- (partial_eta_sq * df_denom) / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  
  # Critical value from central F distribution
  f_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_num, df_denom)
  
  # Power is P(F > f_crit) under non-central F with non-centrality lambda
  power <- 1 - pf(f_crit, df_num, df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(
    n_per_cell = n_per_cell,
    total_N = total_N,
    df_numerator = df_num,
    df_denominator = df_denom,
    lambda = lambda,
    f_critical = f_crit,
    power = power
  ))
}

# Balanced 3-by-2 factorial ANOVA design
# Testing main effect of 3-level factor (Factor A)
# Effect size: partial eta-squared = 0.06
# Alpha = 0.05, target power = 0.80
# Balanced design: n participants per cell, 6 cells total

# Step 1: Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter (lambda)
# For ANOVA F-test: lambda = (f^2 * df_error) / (1 - f^2)
# Or using partial eta-squared: partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_error)
# Therefore: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_error / (1 - partial_eta^2)

partial_eta_sq <- 0.06
alpha <- 0.05
target_power <- 0.80
df_numerator <- 2  # 3 levels - 1 for main effect of Factor A

# Function to compute power given n per cell
compute_power <- function(n_per_cell, partial_eta_sq, df_num, alpha) {
  # Total N = 6 cells * n per cell
  total_N <- 6 * n_per_cell
  # Denominator df in full factorial model: 6(n-1)
  df_denom <- 6 * (n_per_cell - 1)
  
  # Convert partial eta-squared to non-centrality parameter
  # partial_eta^2 = lambda / (lambda + df_denom)
  # Solving for lambda: lambda = partial_eta^2 * df_denom / (1 - partial_eta^2)
  lambda <- (partial_eta_sq * df_denom) / (1 - partial_eta_sq)
  
  # Critical value from central F distribution
  f_crit <- qf(1 - alpha, df_num, df_denom)
  
  # Power is P(F > f_crit) under non-central F with non-centrality lambda
  power <- 1 - pf(f_crit, df_num, df_denom, ncp = lambda)
  
  return(list(
    n_per_cell = n_per_cell,
    total_N = total_N,
    df_numerator = df_num,
    df_denominator = df_denom,
    lambda = lambda,
    f_critical = f_crit,
    power = power
  ))
}

# Search for minimum n that achieves >= 0.80 power
power_results <- list()
for (n in 1:200) {
  result <- compute_power(n, partial_eta_sq, df_numerator, alpha)
  power_results[[n]] <- result
  
  if (n <= 50 || n %% 10 == 0 || (n >= 30 && n <= 60)) {
    cat(sprintf("n=%3d: power=%.6f, df_denom=%3d, lambda=%.4f\n",
                n, result$power, result$df_denominator, result$lambda))
  }
}

# Find minimum n achieving target power
min_n <- NA
for (n in 1:200) {
  if (power_results[[n]]$power >= target_power) {
    min_n <- n
    break
  }
}

cat("\n=== RESULT ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Minimum n per cell for 80%% power: %d\n", min_n))

# Display results for selected sample sizes around minimum
min_result <- power_results[[min_n]]
cat("\nAchieved design (minimum n):\n")
cat(sprintf("  n per cell: %d\n", min_result$n_per_cell))
cat(sprintf("  Total N: %d\n", min_result$total_N))
cat(sprintf("  df_numerator: %d\n", min_result$df_numerator))
cat(sprintf("  df_denominator: %d\n", min_result$df_denominator))
cat(sprintf("  Non-centrality parameter (lambda): %.6f\n", min_result$lambda))
cat(sprintf("  F-critical (alpha=0.05): %.6f\n", min_result$f_critical))
cat(sprintf("  Achieved Power: %.6f\n", min_result$power))

# Check preceding design
if (min_n > 1) {
  prev_result <- power_results[[min_n - 1]]
  cat("\nPreceding admissible design (n-1):\n")
  cat(sprintf("  n per cell: %d\n", prev_result$n_per_cell))
  cat(sprintf("  Total N: %d\n", prev_result$total_N))
  cat(sprintf("  df_denominator: %d\n", prev_result$df_denominator))
  cat(sprintf("  Non-centrality parameter (lambda): %.6f\n", prev_result$lambda))
  cat(sprintf("  F-critical (alpha=0.05): %.6f\n", prev_result$f_critical))
  cat(sprintf("  Power: %.6f\n", prev_result$power))
}

# Store results for final output
final_result <- list(
  min_n_per_cell = min_n,
  achieved_power = min_result$power,
